Select: activities.activity_id, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, compound_structures.canonical_smiles
Source: activities, compound_structures, assays, molecule_dictionary
Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id; activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno; assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1040694'
Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1040694'
Sort: activities.standard_value ASC
Limit: 100
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.activity_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays AS a2 ON a.assay_id = a2.assay_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a2.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1040694'
ORDER BY a.standard_value ASC;
